description: Return this organisation's Aeroz verification volume and outcome breakdown over a recent period. Use for reporting on scan volume, authentication failure rates, and trend. The buckets — authentic, recalled (any tap whose answer carried a recall, verified or not), mismatched (failed static or SUN signature), not_found, unverified (no or unchecked signature, test tag, held or disabled unit) and other — always sum to total.
name: get_usage
title: Usage
